content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need assistance. I completed a [product_name] project and uploaded it to AWS. Several times a year, the panel's power supply is interrupted for 5-6 days. When this happens, the web page continues to display the previous state until power is restored. How can I detect if my [product_name] is powered off? How can I visualize this in the [product_name] project?
One simple solution is to use a flashing indicator controlled by a small graphic element.

Hello, With the [product_name], the only method is as [user_name] suggested. If you can write code for AWS, you could monitor timestamps for any value and create a program to check if the timestamp updates. If it does not change, that means the [product_name] is no longer communicating values to AWS. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users integrating [product_name] projects with AWS Cloud encounter difficulty knowing remotely if their [product_name] device is powered off. The user interface hosted on AWS only reflects the last known state before power interruption, risking misinterpretation of the device’s actual status.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a clear way to remotely detect and visualize when their [product_name] device loses power directly within the project interface hosted on AWS.
